note: Integrated official v0.2.19 with scoped admin API keys, image-count billing, Grok model catalog diagnostics and the custom unified security audit preserved. r4 fixed a production panic in account scheduler degradation probes (duplicate wg.Done drove the WaitGroup counter negative when a probe batch exceeded the worker count of 4). r5 renders the group degradation strip as a real time series: probes are aggregated into rounds (a new round starts when the gap between consecutive probes exceeds 75% of the configured interval), each strip cell is one round, and the verdict reuses the existing rule (pass >= degraded is healthy, otherwise degraded). Falls back to the previous account-ratio snapshot when fewer than two rounds exist. No schema changes.
